answers.how: The plane moves about 350 px/s and averages about 234 px in length. Length = 234 × 22.16 / 350.
The plane is about 74 px high. Using the motion-derived scale, height = 74 × 22.16 / 350.
The plane moves straight at constant speed, so displacement = 22.16 × (1.0 − 0.5).
